d:
Bihar ki rajniti men postar ko lekar ek bar phir vivad shuru ho gaya hai. sarkari vigyapan men mukhyamantri nitish kumar ki tasvir najar nahin aane par JDU ne saval uthae hain. parti ka kahna hai ki nitish kumar ki tasvir pure pul par lagaee jaegi. aakhir sarkari vigyapan se nitish kumar ki tasvir gayab hone ke pichhe kya vajah hai aur JDU ke is bayan ke kya hain siyasi mayne? dekhie yah riport...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
